subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: Lessons from World-Changing Decisions
description: A fast breakdown of Lessons from World-Changing Decisions for builders.

hook.text: From Columbus to Zelensky, the decisions that changed the world share common patterns worth remembering.

buildup.text: Timing matters as much as the choice itself. Lincoln, Parks, and the WHO all show that when is as critical as what.

discovery.text: Many world-changing decisions were made with incomplete data. Certainty is rare.

twist.text: The same decision can look brilliant or foolish depending on the outcome. Judging decisions by results alone misleads.

climax.text: The best decisions balance courage and caution, data and intuition, speed and patience. No single rule applies always.

punchline.text: No single formula. The best decisions balance many forces at once.

quiz.question: What do most world-changing decisions have in common?
options: They were based on perfect data
They were made under uncertainty with courage, timing, and balance
They were popular at the time
